Besan halva resipi | besan ka halva resipi | besan ka shira vistrit photo aur vidiyo resipi ke satha. chhole ke aate, ghi aur chini se bana ek klasik bhartiy mithaee ka resipi. yah shayad tyoharon ke mausam ke dauran ya kisi vishesh avasron ke lie banaee gaee sabse adhik mang ki jane vali bhartiy mithaee hai. yah laddu ki tarah kisi bhi any mithaee ki tulna men banana aasan aur saral hai aur ise minton men banaya ja sakta hai.
